name: dsh-note-keeper
description: Note Keeper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: an Obsidian-compatible notes app in the left sidebar - Markdown notes, audio transcription (Greek/English), a retro paint canvas with OCR, attachments, client-side zero-knowledge encryption, tags, full-text search, backlinks and graph - with notes_* tools so models can read and write notes. Go backend.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.check: for f in lib/index.js lib/daemon.js lib/proxy.js lib/security.js lib/tools.js scripts/build.mjs test/*.mjs src/client/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && echo 'all files OK'
scripts.test:server: cd server && go vet ./... && go test -race -count=1 ./...
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:host
scripts.lint: cd server && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && (command -v staticcheck >/dev/null && staticcheck ./... || ~/go/bin/staticcheck ./...) && cd .. && npm run check

author: Loukas "Luca" Tzekos
